name: core.openwop.connections.taxjar
description: TaxJar connection pack (RFC 0095) — api_key provider for the commerce tax-quote seam (ADR 0238 DEF-1). Category is `other` (the openai-images precedent): the normative `category` enum has no `tax` value and the seam resolves this provider by `id` (`taxjar`), not category — no wire/RFC change. When a merchant configures a TaxJar connection, `features/commerce/taxShipping.ts` calls the Sales Tax API (POST https://api.taxjar.com/v2/taxes) at checkout; ANY error/timeout falls back to the flat/manual governance rate — a provider hiccup never blocks a sale. READ quotes (not money movement), so NO commerce-spend gate. Credentials stay host-side, resolved per-call through the Connections authorization choke point; the request carries only the destination address + line amount, never customer contact details. Carries NO secret (ADR 0024 §7).
